retrievalProfile.description: A tight, centered headshot of a bearded subject against a deep black background, framed by elegant script typography in the upper corners.
triggerTerms: bearded man studio portrait black background
excludeWhen: bright or colorful backgrounds are needed

recipe.visualDefinition: A centered, high-detail portrait of a man with a beard and medium-length hair, wearing a dark turtleneck. The lighting is soft and directional, creating gentle highlights on the forehead and nose while the rest of the figure fades into a solid black void. Elegant, white cursive script is positioned symmetrically in the top left and top right corners.
coreVisualRelationships: High contrast between subject skin tones and black background
Soft focus transition from facial features to hair and clothing
coreInvariants: Solid black background with no visible horizon or floor
Symmetrical corner placement for text elements

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The face occupies the central 60% of the frame, cropped tightly at the shoulders.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The eyes of the subject serve as the primary focal point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes lead to the forehead, then outward to the script in the corners, then down to the beard and texture of the sweater.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive black negative space surrounds the head, emphasizing the subject's presence.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep black background and dark clothing
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Warm skin tones and light brown hair
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Pure white for the corner typography
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation overall with high value contrast between the face and the background.

letterConstructionRules: High stroke contrast between thick downstrokes and thin upstrokes
Extensive decorative swashes on capital letters
Connected lowercase letters with fluid transitions
characterSpecificRedesigns: Extended swashes on initial capitals to fill corner space
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single script face used for both name and title for formal consistency.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the formal, high-contrast calligraphic style.
Provides similar decorative swashes and elegant weight.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-detail studio portrait of a man with a beard and medium-length hair, wearing a black turtleneck, centered against a solid black background with soft, warm lighting on the face.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add white formal script text in the top left and top right corners, ensuring the text is small and elegant.

verificationChecks: Is the typography placed only in the top corners?
Is the script font high-contrast and elegant?

mustRedesign: Any text that obscures the facial features
postGenerationChecks: Verify skin tones look natural under soft light
Ensure no background elements are visible
recipe.reuseFormula: Centered Portrait + Black Void + Corner Script = Classic Professional Profile
